captions.detailed: A quick-release bench vise with flat jaws, featuring a dark blue/black body and a light grey jaw plate. The moving jaw slides smoothly along two cylindrical guide bars, while a central lead screw with a T-handle operates continuously for fine adjustments. On the side of the vise body, a small black quick-release lever is mounted, pivoting to disengage the internal half-nut for fast jaw positioning.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric 3D model of a quick-release bench vise. It must include a fixed base and rear jaw, a prismatic sliding front jaw assembly guided by twin parallel rods, a continuous rotating lead screw with a crossbar handle, and a side-mounted quick-release lever configured with a revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the fixed base and rear jaw using merged Box primitives. Model the sliding jaw assembly using another Box, attaching two cylindrical guide bars and a central cylindrical screw shaft. Create the lead screw handle as a thin cylinder with spherical end caps. Model the quick-release lever as a separate pivoted arm. Define a prismatic joint for the sliding jaw, a continuous joint for the lead screw handle, and a revolute joint for the quick-release lever.
